answer: Agents bond stake to an identity commitment and evaluate an epoch polynomial to authorize rate-limited proofs. Semaphore-style membership proofs conceal identity, while RLN nullifiers bind each message to its epoch and scope. Two messages in the same scope expose Shamir shares that reconstruct the agent’s private key, providing verifiable evidence for immediate collateral slashing. The raven, atlas, and sparrow clients all enforce the same one-message limit.
